page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors. The instance features 128 physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. It utilizes a dedicated CPU allocation model with 1.0 thread per core, running on a KVM hypervisor.

This server type is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory-to-CPU ratio positions this instance in the memory-optimized hardware class. This resource density is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require large in-memory datasets but do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Tradeoffs include the complete reliance on network-attached storage and the lack of hardware accelerators. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
